mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_id, scope_type, scope_value, status, version, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id FROM channel_data_scope WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND scope_type = #{scopeType} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM channel_data_scope WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND scope_type = #{scopeType}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO channel_data_scope (channel_id, scope_type, scope_value, status, version, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES
